name: Seoceo Reward & Share Poster (打赏分享海报插件)
author: 沃之涛

sections.description:
This plugin is part of our long-term WordPress engineering practice.
External Services
This plugin integrates with several external services to provide its core functionality. Below is a detailed breakdown of each service, including their purpose, data transmitted, and relevant policies:
1. art.seohnzz.com API Services
Service Provider: 沃之涛科技
Terms of use:https://www.seoceo.cn/index/index/server
Privacy Policy: https://www.seoceo.cn/index/index/server
1.1 Authorization Verification Service
Endpoint: https://art.seohnzz.com/api/money/log2
Purpose: Verifies the user’s authorization key to enable plugin functionality.
Data Transmitted:
Website domain name
Authorization type (fixed as “8”)
User-provided authorization key
When: Triggered when the user clicks “Authorize Now” in the plugin settings.
1.2 Authorization Status Check
Endpoint: https://art.seohnzz.com/api/index/pay_money
Purpose: Checks if the user has valid authorization to use premium features.
Data Transmitted:
Website domain name
Authorization type (fixed as “8”)
When: Executed when the user saves plugin settings.
1.3 Purchase Verification & Version Check
Endpoint: https://art.seohnzz.com/api/money/level8
Purpose: Verifies the user’s purchase status and retrieves the latest plugin version number.
Data Transmitted:
Website domain name
When: Loaded when the plugin’s admin page is accessed.
1.4 Announcement Service
Endpoint: https://art.seohnzz.com/api/rank/gonggao
Purpose: Retrieves plugin-related announcements and updates.
Data Transmitted:
Content type (fixed as “8”)
Page number for pagination
When: Loaded when the plugin’s admin page is accessed (no authorization required).
1.5 Installation Statistics
Endpoint: https://art.seohnzz.com/api/sanheyi/index
Purpose: Collects anonymous usage statistics to improve the plugin.
Data Transmitted:
Website domain name
Plugin version
WordPress version
PHP version
A hashed value of the domain (for unique identification)
When: Triggered during plugin activation and periodic usage.
1.6 Customer Service QR Code
Resource: https://art.seohnzz.com/static/index/images/mxl/wxqun_qrcode.png
Purpose: Displays a WeChat group QR code for user support.
Data Transmitted: None (only loads an image)
When: Displayed on the plugin’s admin page. The image is updated weekly.
2. ceshig.zhengyouyoule.com Services
Service Provider: 沃之涛科技
Terms of use: https://www.seoceo.cn/index/index/server
Privacy Policy: https://www.seoceo.cn/index/index/server
2.1 Payment & Authorization Service
Endpoint: https://ceshig.zhengyouyoule.com/api/index/pay_money
Purpose: Handles payment processing and authorization status checks for premium features.
Data Transmitted:
Website domain name
Service type (fixed as “8”)
When: Triggered when users attempt to access premium features or check their authorization status.
3. seoceo.cn Services
Service Provider: 沃之涛科技
Terms of use: https://www.seoceo.cn/index/index/server
Privacy Policy: https://www.seoceo.cn/index/index/server
3.1 Customer Support Forum
URL: https://www.seoceo.cn/fswd
Purpose: Provides a platform for users to get help with plugin issues.
Data Transmitted: None directly through the plugin (users interact with the forum directly after login)
When: Accessible via a link in the plugin’s admin page.
3.2 Official Website
URL: https://www.seoceo.cn
Purpose: Provides plugin information, updates, and support contacts.
Data Transmitted: None directly through the plugin
When: Accessible via a link in the plugin’s admin page.
4.Open Source Components
This plugin uses index-xyuWQU0F.js for some interface components. The source code is available at: https://gitee.com/wo-zhitao/plugin—three-in-one
5.QQ Zone sharing link: https://sns.qzone.qq.com/cgi-bin/qzshare/cgi_qzshare_onekey
Purpose: To enable one-click sharing of content to QQ Zone.
QQ sharing link: https://connect.qq.com/widget/shareqq/index.html
Purpose: To enable sharing of content to QQ.
Weibo sharing link: https://service.weibo.com/share/share.php
Purpose: To enable sharing of content to Weibo.
These links are only used to provide social sharing functionality, facilitating users to spread plugin-related or site content.

    By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and conditions of all mentioned third-party services. All data transmissions are encrypted and only used for the specified purposes.
sections.installation:
Method 1: Online installation (recommended)

Enter the WordPress dashboard, click “Plugins – Add New”, search for the keyword “Reward/Share/Poster”, find the “Seoceo Reward & Share Poster” plugin in the search results, and click “Install Now”;
After the installation is completed, activate the Seoceo Reward & Share Poster plugin.
Enter the plugin settings interface through “Settings” -> “Seoceo Reward & Share Poster”.

Method 2: Upload installation

FTP upload installation

Unzip the plugin compression package, and upload the decompressed folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory under the WordPress installation directory.
Visit the WordPress dashboard, enter “Plugins” – “Installed Plugins”, find “Seoceo Reward & Share Poster” in the plugin list, and click “Activate”.
Enter the plugin settings interface through “Settings” -> “Seoceo Reward & Share Poster”.

Dashboard upload installation

Enter the WordPress dashboard, click “Plugins – Add New”;
Click the “Upload Plugin” button at the top left of the interface, select the plugin compression package downloaded locally in advance and click “Install Now”;
After the installation is completed, activate the Seoceo Reward & Share Poster plugin;
Enter the plugin settings interface through “Settings” -> “Seoceo Reward & Share Poster”.
sections.faq: Seoceo Reward & Share Poster integrates multiple trivial functions, making it easy for websites to integrate them.

short_description: Including functions such as tipping, sharing, and generating posters from article inner pages.
